requirements.missing: No document describes a specific alfalfa research study that used a named soil moisture sensor (tensiometer, FDR/TDR capacitance, gypsum block) with an explicitly stated trigger threshold in original units and demonstrated how the farmer/system acted on readings instead of a calendar schedule. s10 describes sensor types generically; s11 gives general alfalfa thresholds (80-150 kPa) without tying them to a named sensor method or farmer decision workflow versus calendar; s12 and s14 use corn examples or general guidance.

s11 provides alfalfa MAD 50-60%, soil water tension 80-150 kPa/cb, and %VWC by soil type but does not distinguish crop ETc from applied irrigation water volume, nor specify growth-stage or season adjustments to the threshold. s10 covers sensor units (kPa, cbar, %VWC) and general methodology but does not present alfalfa-specific threshold data with ETc/application separation or stage adjustments.
